## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards related to IT service management, operational procedures, service delivery, and performance management to ensure consistent service quality and operational excellence across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/itsm-operations/README.md#examples-of-itsm-operations-standards]

## Examples of ITSM Operations Standards

- Service catalog design and management standards for consistent service offerings
- Incident and problem management procedures for effective issue resolution
- Change and release management standards for controlled system changes
- Service level management and reporting standards for performance tracking
- IT service continuity planning standards for business resilience
- Configuration management database (CMDB) standards for accurate asset tracking
- Service desk operations and escalation procedures for customer support
- IT service monitoring and performance standards for operational visibility
- Capacity and availability management standards for service reliability
- Knowledge management standards for operational knowledge sharing
